description: Jo, an independent DJ, must decide whether to accept an informal booking for a rooftop party and settle the fee, set, meal compensation, and sound setup after checking the terms with the organizer, a cafe owner who made another offer, and the site's sound technician.

agents.name: Cal
agents.role: Cafe owner familiar with another booking option

shared_context.S1: Rina is organizing a rooftop party at Riverside Plaza for Saturday evening and wants Jo to provide the music.
shared_context.S2: Jo will make the final decision about whether to accept and what terms to record.
shared_context.S3: The party is planned as an informal arrangement between the organizer and the DJ, with payment and practical terms agreed verbally.
shared_context.S4: Riverside Plaza has venue sound equipment available for events, and the rooftop's power capacity is limited.
shared_context.S5: The rooftop party will need its music equipment and performance arrangements settled before Saturday evening.
shared_context.S6: Rina wants the final verbal terms written down in the booking record.
shared_context.S7: The booking record for the rooftop party must list the agreed fee, set timing, meal compensation, and sound requirements before Saturday evening.
shared_context.S8: Rina will use the booking record to coordinate payment and the performance setup with Jo and the venue.

PF1.text: Rina's exact offer is a 45-minute DJ set beginning at 20:00 on Saturday for $180 and two meal vouchers.

PF2.text: The owner of Cedar Cafe offered Jo $240 for a 60-minute set on Sunday at 17:00 with no meal vouchers; Cal heard the offer directly during an afternoon booking inquiry and has not told the group yet.

PF3.text: Dev inspected the rooftop power and sound area and confirmed that the setup must use the venue's battery PA, must not use a subwoofer, and must include a soundcheck at 19:30.

acceptance_conditions: Jo must accept Rina's Riverside Plaza booking.
The booking must be for a 45-minute set beginning at 20:00 on Saturday.
The fee must be exactly $180 and the settlement must include exactly two meal vouchers.
The Cedar Cafe alternative must be recorded as $240 for a 60-minute set on Sunday at 17:00 with zero meal vouchers.
The sound plan must use the venue battery PA, prohibit a subwoofer, and include a 19:30 soundcheck.
A booking commitment addressed to Rina must be recorded.
Jo must cite Rina's offer, Cal's alternative offer, and Dev's sound inspection in the justification.

content_checks.C4: decisions['alternative_offer_fee'] == 240 and decisions['alternative_offer_day'] == 'Sunday' and decisions['alternative_offer_start'] == '17:00' and decisions['alternative_offer_length_minutes'] == 60 and decisions['alternative_offer_meal_vouchers'] == 0
content_checks.C5: (decisions['sound_pa'] == 'venue battery PA system' or decisions['sound_pa'] == 'Venue battery PA system' or decisions['sound_pa'] == 'venue battery PA' or decisions['sound_pa'] == 'Venue battery PA' or decisions['sound_pa'] == 'Venue battery PA system' or decisions['sound_pa'] == "Venue's battery PA" or decisions['sound_pa'] == "Venue's battery PA system" or decisions['sound_pa'] == 'battery PA' or decisions['sound_pa'] == 'Battery PA' or decisions['sound_pa'] == 'battery') and decisions['subwoofer_allowed'] == False and decisions['soundcheck_time'] == '19:30'

decisive_facts.why: Rina's exact offer changes the settlement to an accepted booking with a Saturday 20:00 start, a 45-minute set, a $180 fee, and exactly two meal vouchers.
Cal's exact Cedar Cafe offer changes the alternative record to $240 on Sunday at 17:00 for 60 minutes with zero meal vouchers.
Dev's site inspection changes the sound plan to the venue battery PA, no subwoofer, and a soundcheck exactly at 19:30.
